about: The base's stock-DSP hook sites and DSP data ledger (docs/OCTATRACK_PACKAGE_DSP_HOOKS.md). Sites: the stock P instructions the base hooks with a permanent JSR into a dormant stub; the stub replays the displaced instruction itself on its dormant path. A site with an exit (a subscriber may skip the stock code after it) names its stock P continuation per payload; a packaged feature's engine (ABI 10) leaves through it with one long branch whose displacement the base writes, so its words are the same on both cores. Indices are an ABI: append only, never renumber. Regions: X/Y words a base feature owns while it is held, which no FX buffer and no package claim may meet. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards only, no stock bytes. `python3 -B sdk/machines/octatrack/dsp_sites.py --write` regenerates resident-runtime/dsp_ledger.h; --check proves this file against the module manifests and resident_dsp.py.
